evidence.why: Renderer-supplied cwd is used directly as the execFile working directory with no validation or confinement to a fixed base directory, allowing git operations against arbitrary filesystem locations.

The git subcommand and all arguments are fully attacker/renderer-controlled strings passed to execFile, allowing arbitrary git subcommands/options (e.g. config, flags with side effects) without an allowlist.

evidence.snippet: runGitCommand: (command, args, cwd) => { return ipcRenderer.invoke('git:run', { command, args, cwd }); }
evidence.why: Preload passes through renderer-chosen command, args, and cwd verbatim to the main process handler.

controls_present: preload exposes named functions rather than raw ipcRenderer
args type-checked as array of strings
other_classes_observed: process.cwd() called in renderer context in index.html (undefined/unsafe without node integration)
